entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: A marshy delta in Benalia on the northern coast of Dominaria, childhood home of Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A region of Dominaria containing the Caligo Morass.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Caligo Morass lies.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: A once-grand estate overshadowing the town of Vess, Liliana's family home.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: A small town at the heart of the Caligo Morass.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who grew up in the Caligo Forest and returned centuries later to rebuild the manor.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, whom she turned into a lich with a false remedy.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A figure Liliana first met while seeking a cure for her sick brother.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A faction under Belzenlok whose rise corrupted the region.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon who led the Cabal.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon to whom Liliana was contracted.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrificed himself on Liliana's behalf.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle that took a heavy toll on Liliana.

events.summary: Liliana grows up in her manor and meets the Raven Man while trying to cure her sick brother.
events.quote: where she first met the Raven Man while trying to find a cure for her sick brother

events.summary: Liliana gives her brother Josu a false remedy that turns him into a lich.
events.quote: This was where Liliana gave her brother Josu a false remedy, which instead turned him into a lich

events.summary: Liliana first planeswalks away, leaving her household and manor to fall.
events.quote: from where she first planeswalked away, leaving her household and manor to fall

events.summary: With the rise of the Cabal under Belzenlok, the forest, town and manor succumb to corruption and decay.
events.quote: the entire region — forest, town, and manor — succumbed to corruption and decay

events.summary: Centuries later, freed from her contracts, Liliana returns and begins rebuilding the manor's husk.
events.quote: She began rebuilding the manor's husk
